name: boatwright
desc: A boatwright in his sixties who works a pitch kettle below his shed: rangy and rope-muscled, tanned and soot-smudged, iron-grey hair tied back short, a drooping grey moustache, one eye narrowed against the smoke. He wears a tan canvas work-shirt with the sleeves cut off, a heavy scorched leather apron dark with tar, a tool roll strapped across his chest, and holds a long-handled tar brush; a smear of pitch marks the back of one wrist. Dry, practical, entirely unbothered.
